name: redis
description: Redis connection details. All redis_* functions take a final `secret` argument naming a secret of this type.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Authentication password if the server requires AUTH. Optional: leave it out to connect without AUTH.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Redis 6+ ACL user name, sent as AUTH username password. Requires password. DuckDB 2.0 build.

parameters.name: db
parameters.description: Database index to SELECT after connecting (default 0). DuckDB 2.0 build.

parameters.name: timeout_ms
parameters.description: Timeout in milliseconds for connecting and for each wait for reply data; overrides the redis_timeout_ms setting. 0 waits forever (the query can still be interrupted). DuckDB 2.0 build.

examples.description: Redis Cloud endpoint with a password
examples.code:
CREATE SECRET IF NOT EXISTS redis (
  TYPE redis,
  PROVIDER config,
  host 'redis-1234.ec2.redns.redis-cloud.com',
  port '16959',
  password 'xxxxxx'
);

examples.description: ACL user, database 2 and a 5 second timeout (DuckDB 2.0 build)
examples.code:
CREATE SECRET IF NOT EXISTS redis_reports (
  TYPE redis,
  PROVIDER config,
  host 'cache.internal',
  port '6379',
  username 'reporting',
  password 'xxxxxx',
  db 2,
  timeout_ms 5000
);
